title: Combined tape configuration
statement: For a Boolean input string $x$, an optional cleaning state $s$, an input-head position, two collections of $k$ work-tape contents $D_t,M_t$ and head positions $D_p,M_p$, and an output string, define the configuration on $2k$ work tapes by concatenating the two collections of tape contents and the two collections of head positions, in that order.
hypotheses_covered: The input-head position lies among the $|x|+2$ positions
The output is a Boolean string
